overview.description: The TrueShares Patriot Defense ETF (FLDZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund is actively managed to invest in large- and mid-cap US stocks. The fund commits to donating the majority of its sub-advisory fee or 100% of its net profit, in the form of its management fee to the Folds of Honor Foundation. FLDZ was launched on Jan 3, 2022 and is issued by Truemark Group.
